THIS CCC IS FILED UNDER SECTIONS 11 AND 12 OF THE CONTEMPT OF COURTS ACT, 1971 R/W ARTICLE 215 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA, BY THE COMPLAINANT PRAYING TO INITIATE CONTEMPT PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE ACCUSED FOR HAVING WILLFULLY DISOBEYED THE ORDER DATED 30.5.2022 PASSED BY THIS HON'BLE COURT IN WP No.10501/2022 (KLR-RES)
I.E. ANNEXURE-A.

THIS CCC COMING ON FOR ORDERS THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MR. JUSTICE  N. V. ANJARIA  and  HON'BLE MR JUSTICE K. V. ARAVIND  ORAL JUDGMENT (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE K. V. ARAVIND)

The order brought in contempt is the directions in Writ Petition No.10501 of 2022 dated 30.05.2022.
2.

Learned Single Judge has issued the following directions, "...the petitioner claims to be the beneficiary of an order of land grant by the Tahsildar, the authorities are lawfully obliged to consider the request of the petitioner to enter her name in the revenue records.

Consequently, respondent No.4 is directed to consider the request of the petitioner for entering her name in the revenue records, within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order."
3. The respondents on service of notice have filed compliance affidavit along with an endorsement dated 18.03.2023 and a letter NC: 2024:KHC:50471-DB dated 10.06.2024.
The affidavit is affirmed by Tahsildar, Harohalli Taluka, Harohalli.

Paragraph No.3 of the affidavit reads as, "3. ... The representations of the Complainant have been considered and also that the said land to which the Complainant has sought for entering her name in revenue records on this day has been acquired by the KIADB and the entire acquisition proceedings are completed.

However, the revenue records would aid only to the benefit of obtaining compensation i.e., payable to the land loosers and in the instant case, the Complainant claims to be the beneficiary of the compensation for the land that has been acquired."
4. Further, paragraph No.4 of the affidavit reads as, "4. .....

Once the land is acquired by any authority and acquisition proceedings are completed, there is no provision under the Karnataka Land Revenue Act to effect mutation entries since the Complainant or her predecessor had failed to get the entries effected in their favour even before the acquisition.

However, after verification, it is Smt Kempamma vs Vishwanath V R on 6 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/12633793/
2 confirmed that the grant was genuine and that the land vests with Dasegowda and his legal heirs have a valid right, title and interest over the land.

sentences.text: The endorsement dated 18.03.2023 to this effect is given to the Complainant."
Paragraph No.5 of the affidavit is also relevant, which reads as, "5. .....

The mutation entries to be effected are sought only for the purpose of obtaining the compensation and accordingly a letter/confirmation of their right and title is issued by this Hon'ble Authority so that by placing the same before the Land Acquisition Officer the Complainant can obtain the compensation."

The statements made in the affidavit referred to above are perused along with the contents of the endorsement dated 18.03.2023 and letter dated 10.06.2024 addressed to Special Land Acquisition Officer.
The statements in the affidavit and the contents of the documents filed along with the affidavit would substantially mark compliance of the directions in the order under contempt.
6. In the light of the above, this contempt would not survive for further consideration.

Accordingly,
it is disposed of.
However, it is provided that the complainant has liberty to avail remedies as available in law against endorsement and letter referred herein above.

Sd/-
(N. V. ANJARIA) CHIEF JUSTICE Sd/-
